name: Procurement spend
prompt: Procurement spend: total purchase order value by month, spend by product category, and the top suppliers by total spend.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(date_trunc('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS month,
  SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS spend
FROM purchase_orders
WHERE ordered_at >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND ordered_at <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY month

copy.title: Monthly purchase order spend
copy.caption: Spend peaked in January at $933k, stayed near $800k–$915k through May, then fell to $262k in June.

binding.sql: SELECT p.category AS category, SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_price) AS total_spend FROM purchase_orders AS po JOIN products AS p ON po.product_id = p.id WHERE po.ordered_at >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE) AND po.ordered_at <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 15

copy.title: Spend by category
copy.caption: Electronics leads PO spend, with Metals and Tooling close behind and the rest clustered near $600K.

binding.sql:
SELECT
  s.name AS supplier,
  ROUND(SUM(po.quantity * po.unit_price), 2) AS total_spend
FROM purchase_orders AS po
JOIN suppliers AS s
  ON po.supplier_id = s.id
WHERE po.ordered_at >= CAST({{params.start_date}} AS DATE)
  AND po.ordered_at <= CAST({{params.end_date}} AS DATE)
GROUP BY s.name
ORDER BY total_spend DESC, supplier ASC
LIMIT 10

copy.title: Top spend suppliers
copy.caption: Gulf Plastics leads, but the top eight suppliers are tightly clustered around $630k–$653k.
